title: Decision: Error message truncation to 500 bytes
description: outbox.rs lines 100 and 124 truncate error messages to 500 bytes before storing in last_error column. This prevents unbounded error messages from bloating the database, while keeping enough context for debugging (500 bytes covers most useful error prefixes). The truncation happens at both record_failure and mark_failed boundaries. Rejected alternative: storing full error would trade storage for debugging ease; 500 bytes is a pragmatic middle ground.
